title: The Ice Pattern in the Bird Bath
youtube_title: The Ice Pattern in the Bird Bath | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet noticing is a way of being gentle with the world.
summary: At a library aisle with a slice of sun, Opal finds an ice pattern like lace on the bird bath, thin and not for stepping. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Opal shows Quinn how to look without disturbing it. Nana Ruth looks too, and they leave it where it is.
